name: OmaOpus
author: MaenExists (fork: soumilchoudhary)
description: Lightning-fast, ultra-lightweight YouTube music player for Omarchy OS — soumilv1 fork. Stream any track in under a second, download it as MP3 to your local library with a crash-safe background worker, and play offline. Includes real-time 32-band spectrum equalizer audio visualizer, seamless queue autoplay, persistent favorites, and a sleek top bar widget that runs under 15MB RAM.

barWidget.description: Instant YouTube music streaming, smart queue autoplay, and favorites directly from your top bar with <15MB RAM footprint.
